facts.fact: L'Oeil du Sahel, citing BCEAO 2024 data, says intra-UEMOA e-money transfers made up 7.25% of the value of Burkina Faso's mobile money transactions in 2024.
L'Oeil du Sahel, citing BCEAO 2024 data, puts intra-UEMOA transfers at 7.25% of the value of Burkina Faso's 20,139,735 million FCFA of e-money transactions in 2024.
L'Oeil du Sahel, citing BCEAO 2024 data, says intra-UEMOA e-money transfers made up 5.63% of the value of Mali's mobile money transactions in 2024.
L'Oeil du Sahel, citing BCEAO 2024 data, puts intra-UEMOA transfers at 5.63% of the value of Mali's 18,744,827 million FCFA of e-money transactions in 2024.
L'Oeil du Sahel, citing BCEAO 2024 data, says intra-UEMOA e-money transfers made up about 1.03% of the value of Niger's mobile money transactions in 2024.
L'Oeil du Sahel, citing BCEAO 2024 data, puts intra-UEMOA transfers at about 1.03% of the value of Niger's 480,220 million FCFA of e-money transactions in 2024.
L'Oeil du Sahel says the BCEAO lists 13 participants in Niger authorised to open PI-SPI services to the public, as of 30 September 2026.
L'Oeil du Sahel reports that the BCEAO's 2 October 2026 communique, covering Burkina Faso as a UEMOA state, sets binding rules for interoperable e-money transfers from 2 November 2026.
L'Oeil du Sahel reports that the BCEAO communique requires interoperable e-money transfers in UEMOA, including Burkina Faso, to be routed through PI-SPI from 2 November 2026.
L'Oeil du Sahel cites the UMOA banking commission as recording Orange Money Burkina Faso with 1.210 billion FCFA of capital and 314.818 billion FCFA of e-money outstanding at end 2024.
L'Oeil du Sahel reports that the BCEAO's 2 October 2026 communique, covering Mali as a UEMOA state, sets binding rules for interoperable e-money transfers from 2 November 2026.
L'Oeil du Sahel reports that the BCEAO communique requires interoperable e-money transfers in UEMOA, including Mali, to be routed through PI-SPI from 2 November 2026.

L'Oeil du Sahel cites the UMOA banking commission as listing Orange Finances Mobiles Mali and Sama Money among Mali's e-money institutions, with 162.680 billion FCFA of e-money outstanding at end 2024.
